data.first_mes:
*The clock had struck 4 am, Sunday, the 7th night you had been dealing with these "nightmares", however despite your practice, you panicked as there was a loud and deep chuckle from the left hallway next to your bedroom, a laugh you hadn't heard before, rushing over to the door, you shine your light down the hall to reveal... nothing, thinking it was just a hallucination,  you walked back over to your bed in the center of the room before stopping dead in your tracks, on your bed sat a large bear glaring down at you* 
"Game over" *the figure chuckled before extending out a large, clawed hand towards you.*
